prototypeScope: V1.34: the left and right sole press molds with their screw-down lids (tools, four M2 x 10 each), one Black plate. V1.33 is printed.
knownFitBoundary: Tools. Cavity 0.70 mm on the 0.7 mm tube plus glue film, so the rubber is pressed a little; printed cavity size not measured. If the dry foot rocks or sits high, the print is off; the sole is not glued yet.
processOverrideReason: Black plate: the cavity faces press the rubber, so 0.12 mm layers and ironed tops keep the terraces on the curved wall small; 6 top layers and 40 % infill keep the floor stiff under the clamp (as V1.21/V1.23).

parts.sourceFrame: community-44.stl frame (mm; foot flat bottom at z = 0, foot above); cavity up
parts.poseName: cavity up, flat bottom on the bed
parts.poseOrigin: Cavity up, flat mold bottom on the bed (as the V1.21 molds): the cavity is a height field seen from above, so every surface faces up or is vertical and nothing needs support; floor and curved wall print as ironed tops.

poseCheck.note: print pose = source frame (identity), dropped to the bed

parts.changeReason: New tool: left press mold for the inner tube sole (Shawn 2026-10-24: E6000 grabs too slowly and the cut tube lifts on the rounded edge; clamp the glued tube in a printed mold, leave it to cure, trim after). Cavity = the foot bottom offset 0.7 mm along the normal (tube 0.7 mm between ribs, 0.8 on a rib, measured by Shawn), one plane over the flat; it ends at the plane 2.3 mm, where the rim stays 0.7 mm from the foot so the rubber is not pinched and the excess leaves over the top. Dry, the foot lands on the flat floor and a pencil on the mold top marks the 3.0 mm glue line. Tabs 1.6 mm outside the foot, raised L. press-mold-check.json.
parts.supersedes: nothing (new tool; the V1.21 hot-glue molds are a different tool)

parts.changeReason: New tool: screw-down lid of the left press mold (Shawn 2026-10-24: no weights or clamps at hand, screw a top half down). Underside = the top of the slip-fit foot lowered 0.1 mm where it is above 12.0 mm (bears on 900.6 mm2: the rim and the toe block, right over the curved edge). Four M2 x 10 TAP through 2.4 mm holes into the 1.6 mm post pilots; seated on the posts the foot sits 0.1 mm below the nominal seat, so the rubber is pressed. press-mold-check.json.
